scope: 5000 raw FIFO words across three aliases, caller storage immutability, exact trace/drop counts, exhaustion/rejection without mutation, borrowed input reset and reconfiguration; randomized byte/word/longword control reads/writes with alias coherence and unaffected-byte checks. Prior scan/A/V/CCR/mask/render/cache delegation and RAM retention are checked. No physical FIFO/AICA/G2 behavior, clock generation, audio or pixels is claimed.
